description:
RekaDaily-10k (processed)
	

Short first-person clips cut from the RekaDaily-10k
recordings —
unscripted daily-life video collected through Claru, Reka's
data collection marketplace, recorded by paid collectors in their own homes and
workplaces on head-mounted and handheld phones, across multiple regions.
Every clip carries one dense caption and a multi-question Q&A exchange
written in the second person ("What am I doing in this video?"), so the corpus
drops straight into… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/RekaAI/RekaDaily-10k-processed.
